## About
Arborway Auto was started by Sal Zirilli, and his son Mike, who learned the ropes from his dad, runs the shop today. We work on all makes and models, foreign and domestic, and pair state of the art technology with old fashioned customer service.
Our goal is simple: build lasting relationships with the people in this neighborhood. We'll tell you what your car needs fixed today, what can wait, and, when it comes to that, when it's simply time to look for a new vehicle.
Call ahead for an appointment on weekdays. We're closed on weekends.

## Services
- MA state inspections: We're an MA state inspection facility, so you can get your inspection done right here.
- Engine light diagnostics: Find out what that warning light on your dash actually means.
- Brakes and rotors: One reviewer came in with a loud grinding noise and said we handled the worn brakes and rotors without upselling.
- Tires and alignment: Tire replacement along with alignment, as part of regular maintenance.
- Steering and suspension: Repairs for steering and suspension systems.
- Emission repairs: Repairs to help your car get through emissions.
- Timing belt replacement: Timing belt replacement for all makes and models.
- Exhaust systems: Exhaust system repair.
- Oil changes: Routine oil changes to keep your car running.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on my kind of car?
A: Yes. We service all makes and models, both foreign and domestic.

Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: Yes, please give us a call to set up an appointment.

## What customers say

Basically, I took the car in for the inevitable maintenance that (I’ve learned the hard way from past vehicles) is necessary to keep the stupid thing running.

For all the work, the price was entirely reasonable especially for how quickly they were able to get it done. No BS, super straightforward, friendly, family oriented, and fun to talk to.

When I went to pick up my car at 4:45pm on a Wednesday in peak forest hills/arborway traffic with second waves of school buses approaching, Matt asked me which way I was driving home. I said left towards centre. “Alright I’ll meet you on the other side of the street” then kindly returned my car and keys to me in the direction I was headed.

I was already sold, but that little gesture locked it in for me. I really hate left turns on to south street during rush hour.

I will exclusively be seeking arborway auto services for all my vehicle needs from here on out." (Katherine Mooney, 5/5)
